deck.title: Phase 11 — SmartArt-style visuals (chevrons + bullets, pyramid, cycle)

chevron bullet columns are stride-aligned with each shape
pyramid stacks trapezoids top→bottom (top = triangle); narrow at peak
cycle arranges ovals on a circle with arrow connectors closing the loop

MBA, INSEAD; CFA charterholder

body.heading: What changed
bullets: Chevron flows now lead with a pentagon (flat left edge) — visual cue for 'start here'
Each chevron can carry a bullet column underneath, stride-aligned with the shape pattern
New show_pyramid intent stacks trapezoids; top level is a triangle by construction
New show_cycle intent arranges ovals on a circle with arrow connectors back to the start
All four SmartArt-style intents render on Title Only as engine-composed canvases
